_: Region sheet for hist-heartland (2.5a1b). Talk is seeded from the region's published place records; every trait cites a lore dossier or says inferred.

norms.text: Villages are governed by their tree-minder and naheesh; disputes go to the tree, not a court.
Travel is by raft, rootworm and drifting village; footpaths link near villages. No Imperial road reaches the groves.
A status named aloud binds: a gift or a name given in speech is kept.
Several tribes live here and nowhere else, each with its own breed and custom.

taboos.text: Cutting or burning near a grove; the grove is the city.
Leading outsiders to a Hist without the minder's leave.

values.text: The health of the tree before any person's comfort.
Consensus. Root Talk decides; the Scalded Throne stays empty.
Owing and repaying exactly, counted in kind.

contempts.text: Salt works and tappers that foul the springs.
Couriers of the state who arrive with orders for people who never gave consent.

place.text: This is the centre; every river comes here, so everything arrives in the end.

work.text: Work is tending: trees, pockets, rafts and the worm-roads.

people.text: Ojel are a category, named by what they want, rarely by name.

faction.text: The state's seat is in Helstrom and the city ignores it.

hist.text: The trees speak and the minders listen; that is the whole of government.

empire.text: The Empire never reached Helstrom and was never wanted.

trade.text: The heartland receives and shares out; a village sells beds and rope to travellers and little else.

danger.text: The marsh at Helstrom's gates loses escorts every season.

rumour.text: Talk is of the springs souring and of who brought the salt.

directions.text: Ways are told by landmark and time: a path to the next spring, so many hours on foot, so many days by raft.

addressTerms.text: Strangers are called ojel, or by their errand: courier, tapper, factor.
Elders are addressed by office: minder, naheesh.

oaths.text: By the root that holds us.

neverSaid.text: What the Hist said to its minder, word for word.
The way to the grove by dry ground.

grievances.text: Salt is reaching Greenspring's spring. The Hist there has begun to sicken.
Cult couriers, tappers and Veiled Reed factors use the villages as inns.

rumours.text: An Unbound Root cell has been cutting at the edge of a grove.
The Held Breath's seal leaks more each year. The Waykeepers will not reseal it unpaid.

views.text: The north grows rice and argues over paper; it comes to the trees when it is frightened.
Gideon's people have forgotten their trees and want roads instead.
The river camps pull adults away from their trees and pay them in tallies.
The deeps keep a harder faith and their raiders work the southern tracks.
Blackrose sends bodies and debts; neither is welcome.
The coast tribes keep the old ways and come to Root Talk in good faith.
